AboutNGI.title: About NGI
descriptions: Nagarjuna Group of Institutions (NGI) stands as an icon for enriching education, ethics, practical learning for the benefit of society and for the young aspiring youth of the country. The philosophy and its purpose have been rendered in its identity, expressing and committing to leadership and excellence in professional education and in our students’ careers.

Foreseeing the necessity of professional academic educational facilities that are imbibed in a strong value system. Nagarjuna Group of Institutions was established in the year 1995, under the able leadership and guidance of our founder Shri J.V Ranga Raju, a respectful Industrialist and Philanthropist.
NGI’s mission of pursuing the finest and highest level education from Primary school to Industry ready professional education program is continuing its rapid growth journey.

Creating some of the finest and thorough industry-ready candidates for various professional fields of work has been the hallmark of the institute. The Group boasts of six institutions ranging from primary school to Post-Graduation in Commerce, Management, Pure Science, Computer Applications and Engineering streams. With over 10,000 students and about 800 faculties on board, the campus is vibrant with activities.

AboutVisionMission.title: About NCMS
Aboutdescriptions: Nagarjuna College of Management Studies, the recent addition to Nagarjuna Group of Institutions has been established by Nagarjuna Education Society with an objective to facilitate students with the finest education in the fields of Commerce, Management & Science.

Keeping in view that “Knowledge is Power”; NCMS is trying to reach out to every corner of these areas. The college is affiliated with Bengaluru North University & is located beside NH-44 and shares the 100-acres campus with NCET. NCMS is known for providing excellent facilities, high-quality education and it is also embedded with skill certification courses. It offers undergraduate programs in commerce, business studies, science and postgraduate programs in commerce & management. The unique feature of education at NCMS is its strong focus on skill enhancement and the holistic development of students.

Sections.title: Mission
points: Equipping the students with the skills necessary to respond to the needs and challenges associated with ever-confronting societal demographics.
Driving to provide an excellent educational platform, skill-based programs that are responsive to the commitments of the students.
Empowering the students to meet and exceed demands as active participants in shaping the world.

Leaders.name: Shri. J. V. Ranga Raju
Leaders.designation: Chairman & Secretary of Nagarjuna Group Of Institutions,Director of Nagarjuna Construction Company.
message: Nagarjuna Group of Institutions has been a forerunner in recognising the needs of the industry and integrating knowledge with professional inputs. NGI has been one of the most eminent institutions in providing renowned education today with its world-class mentors, students and alumni. By maintaining a team of core faculty members, who are constantly pushing the frontiers of knowledge, we ensure a futuristic approach that keeps pace with the changing trends in the professional world through our global perspective. Our primary commitment is to find the true potential of our students and equip them for the future, by providing them with the necessary skills, knowledge, and values. We achieve this goal through our unrelenting efforts to enhance quality in education, research, and diversity in our campus.

I consider this a great opportunity, privilege, and an honour to lead such a progressive educational establishment. We at NCMS, help you shape your future by turning your dreams into reality, and prepare you to face the challenges ahead.

Leaders.name: Prof. Manohar Narajji
message: We are at a critical juncture where transmuting academics to the needs of the dynamic industry is cardinal. We at NCMS are focused on building the next generation of leaders, who can adapt to the changing needs of the society, through curricular interventions that are directed towards holistic development. NCMS has made its presence felt in every aspect of our society and at NCMS we have incorporated it alongside a value-based education that is core to our ethos.

As the Director of NES, I feel honored and privileged to be part of an educational institution where every stakeholder is a learner and every day is an opportunity to learn and discover. We look at ourselves as a community of learners, where everyone learns including our teachers. Also, heritage, geographic spread over major cities, range of programmes and the flexibility of its distance teaching, all offers students around the world the ability to tailor their study to local needs and at the same time connect closely with industry, professional, organisations and local communities.

Leaders.name: Dr. Anandamma N
message: Nagarjuna College of Management Studies has the objective of being an active promoter of change by responding to the needs and demands of the times. This is achieved basically through the process of virtuous education, training and research. Nurturing creativity and inspiring innovation are the key elements of successful education, and our college is the perfect amalgamation of both.

Providing ample opportunities in Commerce, Management and Science is one of the most fundamental obligations we owe to our students because in NCMS we are driven by the belief that every student deserves a high quality education. Our college provides a meticulously and carefully planned mix of academics and extra-curricular activities through which all NCMSians have proved that it’s not just studies that the students excel in, but every single endeavor they choose to do.

Campuses.collegeName: Nagarjuna College of Engineering and Technology
Campuses.description: Nagarjuna College of Engineering and Technology (NCET), the top engineering college in Bangalore, started in the year 2001 under the aegis of Nagarjuna Education Society. It is an autonomous college affiliated to Visvesvaraya Technological University, Belagavi, recognised by the Government of Karnataka (GOK), approved by AICTE, New Delhi and accredited with NAAC A+ Grade.

Nagarjuna Degree College, the best degree college in Yelahanka was established in 2013 by Nagarjuna Education Society with an aim to lead the way for individuals into real life careers. This Degree College in Yelahanka is affiliated to Bengaluru City University, recognised by the Government of Karnataka (GOK) and approved by AICTE, New Delhi.

Nagarjuna Pre-University College (NPUC) established in 2015 runs under the guidance of Nagarjuna Education Society. This College was set up with the sole intention of providing an education that aids in achieving academic excellence. It imparts education in Science and Commerce streams. NPUC, Chickkaballapur is considered to be a new and unique educational landmark in the Chikkaballapur region. It stands as a citadel of learning and is committed to develop the minds and intention of the children.

Nagarjuna Pre-University College (NPUC) established in the year 2000 runs under the guidance of Nagarjuna Education Society. The college is one among the top PU Colleges in Bangalore with exceptional teaching methodologies combined with experiential learning and value-added course. With exceptional mentors, this prominent institution imparts education in Science and Commerce streams.

Nagarjuna Vidyaniketan, established in the year 1995 is among the first institutions to be established under the aegis of Nagarjuna Education Society. It is one of the best CBSE and IGCSE schools in Bangalore upholding the vision of excellence and leadership in education. The school emphasises on the creation of leaders and responsible individuals through excellent value-based education.
